_comment_: Template for the AWS Secrets Manager secret 'quintar-ops/dev' in us-east-1. Strip the underscore-prefixed comment keys before pasting into the AWS console — they're just for documentation. Use the 'Plaintext' view in Secrets Manager and paste the resulting JSON object.
_SLACK_BOT_TOKEN_help_: Bot User OAuth Token from api.slack.com/apps -> Quintar Set Day Ops -> OAuth & Permissions. Format: xoxb-... Charlie rotates and shares via 1Password before deploy.
_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET_help_: Basic Information -> App Credentials -> Signing Secret. Hex string. Needed for future interactive-button verification; harmless to include now.
_SESSION_SECRET_help_: Random 64+ char string. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. Currently unused by the server but reserved for future session/JWT signing — populate so we don't have to update the secret later.
